english: I am what you will be; I was what you are

terms.latin: Sum quod eris; fuī quod es.
terms.comment: Traupman gives it as from a Roman tombstone; we have not found it in an ancient text. It is in the verse epitaph that Petrus Alfonsi quotes in the chapter on death of his Disciplīna clēricālis: Sum quod eris; quod es, ipse fuī.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina clericalis, checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
